name: @gabriellsales/substack-mcp

tools.name: create_community_post
tools.description: Start a thread in the publication's subscriber chat. Visible to subscribers: call without confirm first, then with confirm=true once the user approves.

audience.description: Who can see it. Default all_subscribers.

send_email.description: Email the message to subscribers. Default false.

send_push.description: Send a push notification. Default false.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true posts. Only set true after the user approved the preview.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a private draft from Markdown. Local image paths in the Markdown are uploaded to Substack. Returns the draft id and an editor link where the user can preview it. Does not publish.

content.description: Post body in Markdown. Supports headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, lists, quotes, code blocks, horizontal rules and images; local image paths are uploaded. A line with <!-- paywall --> marks where the paywall starts; <!-- subscribe --> inserts the subscribe button.

audience.description: everyone (default), only_paid, founding or only_free. A paywall marker sets only_paid when this is empty.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Post a Substack Note (short post on the Notes feed) now or schedule it. Public: call without confirm first, then with confirm=true once the user approves.

content.description: Note text. Blank lines separate paragraphs.

link_url.description: Optional URL to attach as a link card.

scheduled_for.description: Schedule instead of posting now. RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:00:00-03:00.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true posts. Only set true after the user approved the preview.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft, or cancel a scheduled post and delete it. Live posts are refused. Call without confirm first, then with confirm=true once the user agrees.

post_id.description: Id or URL of the draft to delete.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true deletes. Only set true after the user agreed.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled Note or delete a posted one. Call without confirm first, then with confirm=true once the user agrees.

note_id.description: Id of the note or scheduled note.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true deletes. Only set true after the user agreed.

tools.name: duplicate_post
tools.description: Copy a post or draft, formatting included, into a new private draft.

post_id.description: Id or URL of the post to copy.

new_title.description: Title of the copy. Default: the original title with (copy).

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read one post or draft: title, subtitle, status, audience, links and the full body as Markdown.

post_id.description: Post id, or the editor/post URL that contains it.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Show the publication (name, URL, role, subscriber count, sections with ids) and the other publications on this account.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List drafts, scheduled or published posts of a Substack publication, with ids and links.

limit.description: How many posts to return, 1-25. Default 10.

offset.description: How many posts to skip, for paging. Default 0.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: list_scheduled_notes
tools.description: List scheduled Notes that have not been posted yet.

limit.description: How many scheduled notes to return, 1-50. Default 20.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Publish a draft now or schedule it. On an already published post, pushes its pending edits live, and with send_email=true emails it to subscribers. Public, so call without confirm first, show the preview to the user, and repeat with confirm=true once they approve.

post_id.description: Id or URL of the draft to publish.

send_email.description: Also email the post to subscribers. Default false.

scheduled_for.description: Schedule instead of publishing now. RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:00:00-03:00.

confirm.description: false returns a preview; true publishes. Only set true after the user approved the preview.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Change the title, subtitle, body, audience or section of a draft. Only the fields you pass change; content replaces the whole body. For an already published post this edits its pending version; publish_post makes the edit live.

post_id.description: Post id, or the editor/post URL that contains it.

content.description: New body in Markdown; replaces the whole body. Omit to keep.

audience.description: everyone, only_paid, founding or only_free. Omit to keep.

section_id.description: Section id from get_publication. Omit to keep.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image to Substack's CDN and get its URL plus a Markdown snippet. Not needed for create_draft, which uploads images by itself.

path.description: Absolute path of a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP file, or an image URL to re-host.

publication.description: Publication URL, host or subdomain. Optional; defaults to the configured or primary publication.

instructions: Tools for the user's own Substack publication. Write content in Markdown; images may be local paths or URLs and are uploaded automatically. Drafts are private. publish_post, delete_draft, create_note, delete_note and create_community_post reach readers or delete data: call them first without confirm to get a preview, show it to the user, and only repeat with confirm=true after the user agrees. Use get_publication to see the account's publications and sections.
